prompt: Transcribe the main Greek reading text in the image, in reading order, one line per printed line. Keep book headings, section numbers, summaries, and source attribution headings and credits such as Zonaras, Xiph., Suid., and Tzetzes, including their reference numbers. When a full-width horizontal rule separates a large lower Zonaras comparison panel from an upper Dio fragment panel, preserve BOTH panels and their attribution heading. Exclude the small critical apparatus beneath its SHORT horizontal rule, even if it is Greek. Exclude running headers, page numbers and English translation. Preserve accents, breathing marks, punctuation, editorial brackets and printed hyphens. Do not correct, expand, translate, summarize or explain. Return only the transcription.

overlap.action: collate shared prefix before admitting missing continuation

status: Reviewed OCR source selection; not a claim of served completion.
panel_routing: Keep main Greek text and embedded attribution headings/credits; omit only the small apparatus below its short horizontal rule. On early volumes, a full-width rule separates Dio from the long Zonaras comparison panel: preserve both panels separately, do not discard the latter as a footnote.
